<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918964_theRebbe_845" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918964_theRebbe_845__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even though the Priestly Blessing preceded the blossoming of Aharon's staff, the staff's flowering added a superior quality, like a legal document strengthened by challenge, and this explains the concept of "good almonds" in Likkutei Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that even though the Priestly Blessing was before Aharon's staff blossomed and produced almonds,</t>
    <t s="3">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="4">"And Aharon lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them," and Rashi explains: "He blessed them with the Priestly Blessing"</t>
    <t s="5">[and even then the drawing down of the Priestly Blessing was with speed],</t>
    <t s="6">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="7">after Aharon's staff blossomed, an elevation was added to this.</t>
    <t s="8">For since the matter of the blossoming of Aharon's staff etc. and producing almonds came about through the challenge to the priesthood,</t>
    <t s="9">this is</t>
    <t s="10">analogous to a document that had a challenge issued against it and was upheld in court,</t>
    <t s="11">which has greater force than a document that had no challenge against it.</t>
    <t s="12">And like the advantage of light from darkness.</t>
    <t s="13">And based on this, we may explain what is said in Likkutei Torah at the conclusion of the maamar,</t>
    <t s="14">that there is a "shkidah" (alacrity/almond) for the "motav" (better) and for the "tov" (good),</t>
    <t s="15">and that the almonds of Aharon's staff are good almonds,</t>
    <t s="16">it may be said,</t>
    <t s="17">that this which the maamar brings, that there is a "shkidah" for the "motav," is to hint that in the good almonds of Aharon's staff there is also the quality of the transformation of "motav" into "tov."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The confirmation of Aharon's priesthood through almonds, which signify speed, relates to the transformation of "motav" to "tov," because true speed involves a vessel of peace that enables unlimited blessing even below.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And we may add,</t>
    <t s="1">that this confirmation of Aharon's priesthood after the challenge was through "and it produced almonds,"</t>
    <t s="2">whose significance is speed</t>
    <t s="3">(as above in section 1),</t>
    <t s="4">is because the quality of the transformation of "motav" to "tov" is also related to the matter of speed.</t>
    <t s="5">And the explanation of this may be said,</t>
    <t s="6">for the matter of speed is that even when the influence is drawn down to the lowest levels, it is with great abundance</t>
    <t s="7">(as above in section 8).</t>
    <t s="8">And in order that even below there should be an abundance of influence,</t>
    <t s="9">the lower realm must be a vessel for this.</t>
    <t s="10">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="11">that one of the reasons that the conclusion and seal of the Priestly Blessing is "and may He grant you peace,"</t>
    <t s="12">is,</t>
    <t s="13">that the vessel for abundant blessing,</t>
    <t s="14">even to unlimited abundance</t>
    <t s="15">[for the abundance of influence of the Priestly Blessing is</t>
    <t s="16">(in its root)</t>
    <t s="17">unlimited abundance,</t>
    <t s="18">and as above that the root of the influence of the Priestly Blessing is above the chain of descent],</t>
    <t s="19">is peace,</t>
    <t s="20">for the Holy One, blessed be He, found no vessel that holds blessing for Israel except peace.</t>
    <t s="21">And based on this, we may explain the connection of the quality of transformation to the matter of the speed of almonds,</t>
    <t s="22">for the true essence of speed is,</t>
    <t s="23">that this—that even below the influence is in abundance—is not only because the drawing down from above is not delayed, but also because the lower realm is a vessel for this through the peace within it,</t>
    <t s="24">and the true essence of peace is when even the "motav" is transformed into "tov."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The ultimate perfection of this peace, where even the enemy becomes a friend, will be at the coming of Moshiach, when Jerusalem will dwell open without limits.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the ultimate perfection of this peace</t>
    <t s="1">(that even the enemy is turned into a friend)</t>
    <t s="2">will be with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly,</t>
    <t s="3">for then there will be peace in abundance and blessing in abundance,</t>
    <t s="4">unlimited abundance,</t>
    <t s="5">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="6">"Jerusalem will dwell open,"</t>
    <t s="7">without measurements and limitations.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
